title: Completed Team Onboarding Checklist Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Team Onboarding Checklist artifact data payloads (PMO-05.12).

task.description: The activity, written so that a person who does not know the project can tell whether it is done. "Get set up" is not a task; "reviewed the onboarding document" is.

assigned_to.description: Who does it, which is not the same as who is waiting for it. Most onboarding tasks are somebody's one-off action, and naming the one-off is what stops the new member chasing something nobody owns.

due_date.description: When it should be complete, relative to the joining date rather than to a calendar day, because the joining date moves and a checklist full of fixed dates has to be redone when it does.

status.description: Done or pending, and the date it was done. A checklist nobody updates is one that has quietly stopped being true, and the entry is what shows it has.
